english: MySQL Enterprise Backup (MEB) provides online backup and recovery for MySQL databases, including full, incremental, partial, and point-in-time recovery workflows. It is intended for production environments where backups need to be consistent, restorable, and minimally disruptive to running workloads. Key capabilities include compression, encryption, backup validation, selective restore, and support for backing up to local or cloud storage.
translation: MySQL Enterprise Backup (MEB) 为 MySQL 数据库提供在线备份与恢复，支持完整、增量、部分备份和时间点恢复，适用于需要一致、可恢复且尽量减少对运行中业务影响的生产环境。主要功能包括压缩、加密、备份验证、选择性恢复，以及本地和云存储备份。
